title: Range
description: One entry in an Editor's `ranges` array -- design/developers/plugin_model.md §3 (Range object). Either the min/max shape or the subset shape, matching src/nucore/profile.py's own `Profile.__build_editor__` dispatch (`if "min" in rng and "max" in rng: EditorMinMaxRange ... elif "subset" in rng: EditorSubsetRange`) -- restructured from iox-vscode-plugin's editor.schema.json, which additionally allows a third `{idref}` branch at this level; that branch is intentionally dropped here (see editor.schema.json's description).

prec.description: Precision: number of digits following the decimal point.

step.description: Step increment the UI should use when increasing/decreasing the value.

names.description: Optional mapping of value (as a string key) to display name. See uom_named_states.schema.json for reference tables of well-known named states, e.g. for Thermostat mode (uom 67) -- not enforced here since names are plugin-author-supplied free text.
